reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Netatmo Enhanced
reauth_confirm.description: Authorize Netatmo Enhanced again and grant permission to control Smarther and thermostat devices.

init.title: Webhook settings
init.description: Choose how Netatmo notifications update Home Assistant. Direct update is experimental and uses periodic API polling as a fallback.

set_boost.name: Set Boost
set_boost.description: Start or change Boost in the active season.

cycle_boost.name: Cycle Boost duration
cycle_boost.description: Start at 30 minutes, then cycle through 60 minutes, 90 minutes and stop.

stop_boost.name: Stop Boost
stop_boost.description: End Boost and return the thermostat to the applicable room mode.

set_manual_temperature.name: Set timed manual temperature
set_manual_temperature.description: Set a temporary manual target in the active season.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Manual override duration in whole minutes, from 1 through 720.

application_credentials.description: Create a personal application at https://dev.netatmo.com/ and enter its client ID and client secret. Use a separate application for the official Netatmo integration.
